recommendations.description: Fix async executor anti-pattern in Promise constructor in rate-limiter.ts line 261. This creates unhandled promise rejections and prevents proper error handling.
Implement comprehensive test suite for main() entry point covering argument validation, authentication scenarios, and report generation with 0% current coverage.
Remove debug logging of user input at main.ts line 86 which exposes repository information in production logs. Use logger.debug() instead.
Implement tests for orchestrator.reviewPullRequest() covering all message types, error paths, and structured output validation.
Extract authentication validation logic into separate validateAuthentication() function to improve testability and reduce main complexity by 40 lines.
Refactor orchestrator message handling into separate methods with type guards for better testability and maintainability.
Reduce maxTurns from 30 to 10-15 in orchestrator to prevent unbounded token consumption and unexpected API costs.
Add comprehensive tests for error-handler.ts (withRetry, withTimeout) and rate-limiter.ts (RateLimiter class) with critical async/concurrency logic.
Escape HTML content in report generator to prevent XSS injection from malicious input in recommendation descriptions.
Extract CLI argument parsing and report generation logic into separate functions to improve separation of concerns and testability.
Replace magic string agent names with typed constants to prevent typos and enable TypeScript autocomplete.
Modernize withRateLimit function by removing async executor anti-pattern and using try/finally for cleanup.
Add comprehensive JSDoc comments to orchestrator, rate-limiter, and error-handler explaining complex algorithms and state transitions.
Complete schema validation tests for CodeQualityResultSchema and TestCoverageResultSchema with boundary values and invalid enums.
Break down generateMarkdownReport() into smaller reusable formatting functions and extract emoji mappings.
